task: Customer reports that their order was delivered to the wrong address.
reference: We sincerely apologize for the delivery issue. It appears the order was shipped to an incorrect address due to a system input error. We will contact the courier immediately to investigate and arrange a redelivery to the correct address as soon as possible.
submission: We already told you that delivery issues depend on courier systems and address accuracy. If your package went to the wrong place, it is not our responsibility. You should follow up with the courier because we cannot keep handling repeated mistakes like this.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The response is dismissive, unprofessional, and refuses responsibility or assistance while using a negative tone.

task: Customer is requesting a refund for a product they are not satisfied with.
reference: We are sorry to hear that you are not satisfied with your purchase. We completely understand your frustration. We will process a full refund for you within 5 to 7 business days. Please let us know if there is anything else we can help you with.
submission: Thank you for letting us know about your experience. We are genuinely sorry that the product did not meet your expectations and we want to make sure this is resolved for you. A full refund will be processed back to your original payment method and you should see it reflected within 5 to 7 business days. Please do not hesitate to reach out if there is anything else we can do for you.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply feels genuine and customer-focused. It acknowledges the dissatisfaction clearly, gives accurate refund details, and leaves the door open for further help in a warm professional tone.

task: Customer reports that the website or app is not working.
reference: We are sorry for the inconvenience. Our technical team is currently investigating an issue affecting the website/app functionality. We are working to resolve it as soon as possible and appreciate your patience.
submission: We are sorry for the issue. Our technical team is investigating the problem affecting the service and working on a fix. We appreciate your patience.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The response is correct and polite but slightly less clear in guidance for the user on what to do next.

task: Customer complains that their order has not arrived after the expected delivery date.
reference: We sincerely apologize for the delay. Your order is currently on its way and will arrive within 2 to 3 business days. We understand your frustration and truly appreciate your patience. Please do not hesitate to contact us if you need any further assistance.
submission: Wait for it. Deliveries take time.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply is dismissive and unhelpful. It vaguely implies the order will arrive but offers no apology, no timeline, and no professional tone whatsoever.

task: Customer reports that an item is missing from their delivered order.
reference: We apologize for the missing item in your order. We understand how frustrating this must be. We will ship the missing item to you right away at no extra cost. Please expect it within 2 to 4 business days and let us know if there is anything else we can help you with.
submission: You probably lost it. We cannot send another one for free.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply blames the customer without any basis, refuses to help, and is completely unprofessional, failing every criterion without exception.

task: Customer says their package was marked as delivered but they never received it.
reference: We are truly sorry to hear that your package has not arrived despite being marked as delivered. We understand how frustrating this must be. We will open an investigation with the courier immediately and get back to you with an update within 24 to 48 hours. In the meantime please check with your neighbors or building reception in case it was left there.
submission: The courier marked it as delivered so it should be there. Please check around your building.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply suggests checking the building which is a partial next step, but it implies the customer may be wrong by pointing to the courier status and offers no apology, no empathy, and no investigation promise.

task: Customer says a discount or coupon code they applied did not work and they were charged the full price.
reference: We are sorry to hear that your coupon code did not work as expected. We understand how frustrating that must be. We will apply the discount manually and refund the difference to your account within 2 to 3 business days. Please do not hesitate to contact us if you need any further assistance.
submission: Please send us the coupon code and we will look into it for you.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply asks for the coupon code which is a partial next step, but it includes no apology, no empathy, and gives the customer no information about how or when the issue will be resolved.

task: Customer complains about slow customer service response.
reference: We sincerely apologize for the delay in responding to your request. Due to a high volume of inquiries, our response time has been longer than usual. We appreciate your patience and will assist you as quickly as possible.
submission: If you are waiting, that’s normal. We have too many customers and cannot reply fast. You should stop expecting instant replies.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The response lacks empathy, blames the customer indirectly, and uses an unprofessional tone.

task: Customer complains that their order was cancelled without reason.
reference: We understand your concern regarding the cancelled order. After reviewing your account, the order was cancelled due to a verification issue and could not be processed successfully. We apologize for the inconvenience and recommend trying again with a verified payment method.
submission: We are sorry for the inconvenience. After checking your account, the order was cancelled due to a verification issue. Unfortunately, the payment could not be processed successfully, so the order was not completed.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The response is concise, polite, and clearly explains the cancellation reason while maintaining a professional tone and providing clear information.

task: Customer reports that they received the wrong item in their order and wants the correct one sent.
reference: We sincerely apologize for sending you the wrong item. We completely understand how inconvenient this must be. We will ship the correct item to you right away and arrange a free return for the wrong one. Please expect the correct item within 3 to 5 business days.
submission: We are sorry for the wrong item. We will send you the correct one and arrange a free return for the item you received. Please allow 3 to 5 business days for delivery.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply covers the key points and gives a correct timeline, but it lacks empathy and does not acknowledge the inconvenience caused, making it informative but slightly impersonal.
